# `morphir mck report check`

- **Usage:** `morphir mck report check [FLAGS] <REPORT> <ALLOWED_FAILING>`

Verify report inventory and the binding's allowed-failing baseline

## Arguments
- **`<REPORT>`** — Consolidated JSON report to check
- **`<ALLOWED_FAILING>`** — Binding-owned JSON file listing allowed failing case IDs

## Flags
- **`--kit <KIT>`** — Independent kit, defaulting to the embedded kit
- **`--repo-root <REPO_ROOT>`**
- **`--filter <FILTER>`** — Require this exact case filter; omission requires a full-kit report
